detail.longDescription: Hi HN, I build Valin because my wife needed a way to search across all the saves and all the information she came across online - from recipes, books, children activities, vacation recommendations. She didn't want another AI subscription or another account to manage. Valin was born - an application that allows users to share to it (almost) any kind of contents from applications (videos, audio, links, papers, reels. etc) and it goes in and using on-device AI transcribes audio, extract key frames of the video, extracts text from the frames and shows Key Takeaways and Summary. This allow users to get an at-a-glance overview of what the save was about and it allows the application to cluster and to find similar saves on the device - to generate new collections or to automatically (if enabled) assign saves to existing collections. And in the end it allows the system to support a chat-like interface where users can quickly get the information they need, not just the save. I vibe coded it in the last 5 months and I'm pretty happy how it turned out so I wanted to share the TestFlight beta to see if its interesting or useful to other folks. Features - fully on-device: no cloud services, no AI subscription, no account needed. - supports videos, audio, pdf, images - supports applications: FB, Instagram, Substack, X, Reddit, TikTok, Threads, Voice Memos - supports iPhone (including Duo) and iPad - iCloud sync (optional) to allow cross device sync and processing Limitations: - it can only work with saves that are available or can be read without a subscription (no logins) - it only processes in the foreground or background if you approve it when suggested. Requirements: - iOS only - iPhone 15 pro or newer - iPad with M1 or newer, or the iPad mini with A17 Pro. Models used: - Gemma 4 E2B - for summarization, chat and general information extraction - Embeddings Gemma 300m - for clustering, collection generation and semantic search - Whisper - for transcribing What I'm proud of - there are over 10 TLA+ models which I used to model everything from the DAG that processes the saves, to iCloud sync, to GPU/CPU processing of AI requests (since iOS doesn't allow background GPU processing on the iPhones). It's a beta right now on TestFlight - https://testflight.apple.com/join/gjJQQrqk Would love to hear feedback and suggestions. Daniel
